newsitem.title: CANADA: Statscan survey sees Sept Canada CPI at 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Statscan survey sees Sept Canada CPI at 1.4 pct.

text.p: A Statistics Canada survey of analysts forecast on Tuesday Canadian consumer prices would rise by 1.4 percent in September on a year over year basis.
The survey forecast gross domestic product to rise 0.2 percent in August after a 0.5 percent increase in July. It pegged unemployment at 9.4 percent in September, unchanged from August.

The economists also forecast merchandise exports for August to rise to C$22.6 billion from C$22.1 billion in July, and imports to remain virtually unchanged at C$19.5 billion in August from C$19.4 billion in July. The agency on average surveys 17 economists each month.
